issues.where: sun and sky round it, upper left (region 5)
issues.what: -a has a large blooming sun sitting on the treeline with wide flare rays, glowing broken cloud banks and a thick warm haze plume pouring over the left of the field; -b has a small tight sun disk floating above the treeline, thin streaky clouds, little bloom and almost no haze over the field
issues.fix: lower the sun onto the treeline, widen its bloom and rays, bring back the lit cloud banks round it and the warm haze drifting across the left field

issues.what: -a is a warm, filmic grade with lifted, slightly milky blacks, soft contrast and fine grain; -b is a cleaner, greener, more saturated CG look with crisper contrast and a cooler blue sky
issues.fix: warm the overall grade toward amber, desaturate the greens, lift the blacks slightly and add matching film grain and softness

issues.what: -a has rolling hills and a dense dark treeline across the whole skyline, sitting lower in frame; -b has a flat, empty dark band of bare ground before a thin treeline with odd small bumps, and the horizon sits higher on the left and is flatter
issues.fix: replace the flat band with the -a rolling hills and continuous treeline, and match the horizon height and shape to -a

issues.what: -a field is backlit with heads mostly turned toward the sun, dim and soft with depth falling off into haze; -b heads face the camera brightly, leaves are large and glossy, and the field stays sharp and bright into the distance with little atmospheric falloff
issues.fix: turn the heads away toward the sun, darken and soften the field with distance, and add haze and focus falloff toward the horizon

issues.where: foreground plant leaves (regions 2 and 3, tile b)
issues.what: -a leaves are thin, translucent and rim-lit with a warm edge glow; -b leaves are oversized, waxy and saturated yellow-green with hard yellow edge highlights
issues.fix: reduce leaf size, give them backlit translucency and a soft warm rim instead of the hard yellow edges

issues.where: stem and its hairs (region 2, tile b)
issues.what: -a stem is bright and rim-lit with visible fine hairs; -b stem is dark and smooth with no visible hairs
issues.fix: add a warm rim light along the stem and bring back the fine backlit hairs

issues.what: -a has soft green grass with warm sunlit tufts; -b has dark ground with hard-edged straw patches and long shadow streaks running right
issues.fix: replace the straw patches with green grass and soft, warm sunlit tufts as in -a

issues.what: the flower head is a little smaller and flatter, with more saturated petals and less warm backlit glow round the petal edges than in -a
issues.fix: scale the head up slightly and add a warm translucent rim to the petals
